verdict.rationale: Stagehand's browser configuration docs list a first-party local mode, `localBrowser.launch`, alongside Browserbase. They also document attaching over CDP to any Chromium browser already running on your machine (`localBrowser.connect`) and local user-data directories that persist cookies and storage between runs. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that local mode needs no Browserbase or other cloud account, and independent hands-on corroboration of local-only development.
